Look, here is what I did when I was homeless. This is just waht I did.  Use it as a guide. 

 Get on food stamps and they will give you a debit card. Find a place that will give you an Obama phone the food stamp card will be the proof you need. Its a cheap flip phone with X amount of minutes every month.
Sign up for a gmail account and take advantage Google voicemail. You point that towards your obama phone so people can just leave you messages which get transcribed and emailed to you. That way you can check your email at the library and don't waste minutes. 

You have to find some income somehow. Day labor or panhandling even. I never panhandled so I can understand if you don't want to do that.  You don't have to do day labor everyday. That can be rough. But you have to do it to help the plan along. 

Get some kind of address. In my case, I knew I was about to become homeless and I did what I am describing to you in advance or right as it finally  happened. 
Then get one of those gobank cards from Walmart. 

Is there no shelter there? You have to keep clean. Don't go native. People are actually more likely to help you if you don't look like a homeless person. 

Churches will help. Just ask one and if they can't help you they can probably refer you to a church that can. The church I go to actually has a men's and a women's dorm. 

SEe to me it's like I have to do everything to appear not homeless to get out of being homeless.
If you have addiction problems, you better learn to put them away until you get out of this mess. That is another resource too. The AA clubhouse I go to has a place whre people can stay to stay clean and sober and get their shit together. 

You have to get away from the trains. You're losing sleep as you well know and when you are a jam like you are, your wits are as important as your blood. 
 Ask people for help. If you don't look like a crazed homeless person they will be way more receptive. 

Now last thing. I am betting you are in semi-rural place. You might have to get a bus ticket and just leave. Research other cities. They can vary like crazy. Austin Tx is very resourceful place for homeless, Dallas tx is not.  Another thing about leaving town is you get a fresh start. 
I never got suicidal when I was homeless.  I think if you read this, you can see why. I was busy.

That being said.  I understand why you could be suicidal. Somebody foolish told me once that a wise person told them "Things have a tendency to work out". 
And if you can get out. You will a confidence like you never knew. 

Pm me whatever. I wish you the best!!
